profile_text.body:
RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC., also listed as RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC-CL B, is a for-profit public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with ticker RR and CIK 0001963685. Its website is rolls-royce.com, and the site content presents Rolls-Royce, which describes itself as a pioneer of cutting-edge technologies that deliver clean, safe and competitive solutions to meet power needs. The site says Rolls-Royce has been at the forefront of innovation for more than 100 years and develops complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land.

The site lists announcements including a $1 Billion investment in Indiana, described as cementing Indianapolis as one of the most advanced engine manufacturing and test campuses in the world; a strategic intent with Reliance Industries to develop India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme; co-operate on advanced nuclear technologies with the United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and Japan Atomic Energy Agency; and multiple contractual commitments for Rolls-Royce SMR units in Europe after signing a contract with CEZ Group. No AI products are listed for the company.

No litigation cases are listed for the company, and its Nevada law exposure count is zero.
